How this directory works

Each event page is checked against the organizer's site and lists its sources. Dates and prices change, so the sign-up link always goes to the organizer. Weather is a live forecast for the host town. Town pages list hotels, restaurants and bike shops we could confirm are open. Nothing here is paid placement.

Missing an event? Message us on Instagram and we will add it.
